summary: China Yuchai International filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, reporting unaudited first-half 2026 financial results. The filing is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation event. It details a 13.9% revenue increase to RMB 14.7 billion, a 36.5% gross profit rise, and a 57.4% profit increase. No M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation activity is disclosed. The document is strictly an operational and financial update, so no deal terms or extraordinary corporate actions apply.
